newsitem.title: USA: Columbia/HCA division buys Va. hospital.
newsitem.headline: Columbia/HCA division buys Va. hospital.

text.p: Columbia Arlington Healthcare System LLC, a joint venture of Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corporation and the Arlington Healthcare System, said Wednesday it bought National Hospital Medical Center in the first expansion since forming their partnership in November 1996.
Columbia Arlington Healthcare System purchased the 154-bed hospital in Arlington, Va. and renamed it Columbia Pentagon City Hospital, the company said in statement.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

Columbia/HCA is the biggest health care services company in the United States with operations in 36 states and more than 1000 separate facilities, including hospitals, surgery centers and home health locations.
